title: Complete tenant activation from registration through onboarding to dashboard access
description: A new tenant can register, complete onboarding with a paid plan via PIX, and then access the dashboard with an active tenant.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill a valid name into the name field
Fill a unique valid email into the email field
Fill a valid password into the password field
Fill the same valid password into the confirm password field
Submit the registration form
Wait for the onboarding page to load
Select an available plan
Initiate the checkout for the selected plan
Complete the PIX payment steps in the app until returning to the application flow
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Paid plan enrollment auto-creates a pending invoice visible in organization payments
description: When a student is enrolled in a paid plan, a pending invoice is automatically created and appears in the payments list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /app/alunos
Open the add-student flow
Fill a valid student name into the name field
Fill a valid CPF with 14 characters into the CPF field
Select a plan with price greater than 0
Select a valid start date
Select a valid due date
Save the student
Click the navigation to the payments area
Verify a pending invoice is displayed for the newly created student

title: Register a student with full details and assigned plan
description: A staff user can add a new student with contact and address details, assign a plan and dates, and see the student in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /app/alunos
Open the add-student flow
Fill a valid student name into the name field
Fill a valid CPF with 14 characters into the CPF field
Fill a valid phone number into the phone field
Fill valid address fields (street, number, neighborhood, city, state, zip)
Select an available plan
Select a valid start date
Select a valid due date
Save the student
Verify the newly created student appears in the student list

title: Create and assign a workout to a student
description: An instructor can create a new workout with at least one exercise and save it so it appears as assigned to the selected student.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the workouts area
Start creating a new workout
Select a student from the list
Add an exercise from the exercise library
Fill valid sets into the sets field
Fill valid reps into the reps field
Select a valid rest time for the exercise
Save the workout
Verify the workout is listed for the selected student

title: Free plan enrollment does not create any pending invoice
description: When a student is enrolled in a free plan, no pending invoice is created and it does not appear in the payments list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /app/alunos
Open the add-student flow
Fill a valid student name into the name field
Fill a valid CPF with 14 characters into the CPF field
Select a plan with price equal to 0
Select a valid start date
Select a valid due date
Save the student
Click the navigation to the payments area
Verify there is no pending invoice shown for the newly created student

Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the payments area
Select a pending invoice from the list

Verify a copyable PIX payload is displayed

title: Regenerate PIX for the same pending invoice
description: Staff can generate PIX for the same pending invoice more than once and still see a QR code and payload each time.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the payments area
Select a pending invoice from the list
Generate a PIX payment request
Close the PIX details view
Select the same pending invoice again
Generate a PIX payment request
Verify a PIX QR code is displayed
Verify a copyable PIX payload is displayed

title: Registration form blocks invalid inputs and allows successful submission after correction
description: A user sees validation errors for invalid registration inputs and can correct them to successfully submit registration.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill a name shorter than 3 characters into the name field
Fill an invalid email into the email field
Fill a valid password into the password field
Fill a different password into the confirm password field
Submit the registration form
Fill a valid name into the name field
Fill a unique valid email into the email field
Fill the same valid password into the confirm password field
Submit the registration form
Verify the user reaches the next step after registration

title: Block PIX generation for a zero-value invoice
description: Staff cannot generate PIX for an invoice with value equal to zero and is shown a validation error instead of a QR code.

steps.description: Navigate to /login

Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the payments area
Select an invoice with value equal to zero
Attempt to generate a PIX payment request
Verify a PIX generation validation error is visible
Verify no PIX QR code is displayed
